reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT x.plan_id, SUM(x.refunded_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(x.payment_amount), 0) AS refund_rate FROM (SELECT s.plan_id, p.payment_id, p.amount AS payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS refunded_amount FROM subscriptions s JOIN invoices i ON i.subscription_id = s.subscription_id JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id AND p.status = 'captured' LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id GROUP BY s.plan_id, p.payment_id, p.amount) x GROUP BY x.plan_id ORDER BY x.plan_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: SELECT plan_id, SUM(refunded) / NULLIF(SUM(captured),0) AS refund_rate FROM (SELECT s.plan_id, p.amount AS captured, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM refunds r WHERE r.payment_id=p.payment_id),0) AS refunded FROM subscriptions s JOIN invoices i ON i.subscription_id=s.subscription_id JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id WHERE p.status='captured') q GROUP BY plan_id ORDER BY plan_id
